data.description:
## Problem

`src/rebar/llm/runner.py` is now **exactly 800 LOC**, which is the repo hard cap in `.github/module-size-limit.txt`. The CI module-size gate compares with `$1 > lim` (strictly greater), so 800 PASSES today — but there is **zero headroom**: the next line added to this file fails Verified for everyone.

This is a pre-existing condition, not caused by any single story: runner.py was 787 before story dc0d (S4) and 783 before 7468 (S1). AGENTS.md targets **200-500 LOC** per file, so runner.py is well past target and has been for a while.

It is an imminent blocker: stories 2932 (native Bedrock provider) and 343b (signed verdict provenance) in epic 061c both still need to touch runner.py.

## Why this was NOT fixed inside S4

The obvious quick move — relocating `_pai_check_config` (~28 LOC) to `config.py` — just relocates the pressure: `config.py` is 768 LOC, so it would land at ~796, equally out of headroom. A new 30-LOC module is also ruled out: AGENTS.md forbids creating files under 100 LOC by splitting. So this needs a REAL seam analysis, which is its own piece of work rather than a hasty shuffle bolted onto an unrelated story.

## Approach

Identify an existing call-graph cluster in runner.py that already calls itself and extract it whole (per AGENTS.md: split only along seams that already exist, never mechanically to hit a number). Candidate clusters visible today, to be confirmed by analysis rather than assumed:

- the structured-output driver (`_pai_structured` + the bounded retry loop + `effective_max_iterations` / `effective_max_tokens`) — already a fairly self-contained unit;
- the telemetry/usage cluster (`_extract_usage`, `_warn_if_zeroed_usage`, the step-usage logging);
- the agent-build invariants (`_check_tool_capability` + `_TOOL_CAPABILITY_CHECKED`).

Prefer whichever extraction leaves both files inside 200-500 and needs no import from runner back into the new module (the leaf convention `anthropic_model.py`/`providers.py`/`capabilities.py` already follow).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] no file under `src/rebar` exceeds **700** LOC, giving real headroom rather than sitting on the cap
- [ ] the extracted module is a LEAF: it imports nothing from `runner`, and `grep` confirms it
- [ ] the extracted module is >= 100 LOC (AGENTS.md forbids sub-100-LOC splits)
- [ ] the split is behavior-preserving: the FULL gating suite (`make test`) passes with no test changes other than import-site moves
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck` pass and the module-size gate reports OK
data.title: Split runner.py along a call-graph seam — it sits at exactly the 800-LOC hard cap
